name: Deluxe
description: Deluxe Merchant Services is a trusted leader in both payments and data-driven marketing. By combining innovative technology services with industry-leading expertise, we’ve built a robust suite of payment solutions that empower government agencies to scale efficiently, accelerate growth, and foster profitable customer connections. Whether it’s managing high-volume transactions, seamlessly integrating multiple payment sources, or transitioning into the digital economy, we make it all work smarter, faster. To accelerate your payment offering, visit https://www.deluxe.com/who-we-serve/government/.

name: Dexter Strategies
description: Dexter Strategies is a Wisconsin-based marketing and communications consultancy helping municipalities, businesses, and mission-driven organizations achieve meaningful results. With more than 20 years of experience, we specialize in strategic planning, branding and messaging, integrated marketing campaigns, website strategy, and community engagement. We also specialize in digital accessibility and WCAG compliance, offering consultations, accessibility assessments, practical guidance, and staff training to help municipalities create more accessible communications. From strategy through execution, we deliver personalized, practical solutions tailored to your organization's goals, resources, and audiences. At Dexter Strategies, we believe the right strategies lead to real, measurable impact for your community.

name: Ehlers
description: A pioneer in municipal advisory services since 1955, Ehlers helps clients build strong, vibrant and sustainable communities by delivering independent, integrated advice across all areas of public finance. We work with more than 1,500 local governments, schools, and public agencies across five states, placing our clients’ needs and best interests at the center of everything we do.

name: Enbridge Energy
description: Energy Transportation Company

name: Energy Performance Lighting
description: When it comes to design-build lighting upgrades, Energy Performance Lighting is unmatched. We work with you on the design, budgeting, funding the upgrade, installing and commissioning the lighting, and providing an owner’s manual. Very seldom, if ever, do you get this complete a package from another “lighting” company. Energy Performance Lighting makes upgrading to LED lighting simple and easy.

name: Engberg Anderson
description:
Engberg Anderson is an architecture, planning, & interior design firm with a long history of delivering innovative, adaptive and high-functioning projects across a range of civic design categories. Our team brings a creative and thorough planning and design process that delivers solutions to not only exceed clients’ expectations but carefully reflect the communities in which they are built. 

Our service facilities are combined with expertise in developing mixed use and targeted multi-family housing, sites and urban master plans that transform neighborhoods and encourage growth. We design with future needs in mind.

name: Enterprise Lighting
description: Enterprise Lighting & Controls is a manufacturer rep agency for the state of Wisconsin. We represent over 100 manufacturers servicing lighting municipals, utilities and the department of transportation.

name: E-Plan Exam
description: E-Plan Exam is a commercial plan review firm serving 50+ municipalities and 1.4 million residents across the state of Wisconsin for every trade. Founded in 2019 and acting under state authority as communities' plan review agent, our 25 top plan examiners — professional engineers, architects, code professionals, master plumbers, and fire chiefs — are experts across the ICC I-Code suite, putting qualified eyes on every discipline under one roof. Every review carries a 15-business-day guarantee, no appointment needed. A 2024 BizTimes Future 50 fastest-growing company in southeastern Wisconsin, E-Plan has processed 10,000+ reviews with turnaround well ahead of state timelines.

name: Focus on Energy
description: Focus on Energy is Wisconsin utilities' statewide energy efficiency and renewable resource program funded by the state's investor-owned energy utilities and participating municipal and electric cooperative utilities. The Program works with eligible Wisconsin residents and businesses to install cost-effective energy efficiency and renewable energy projects.

name: GIPAW
description: GIPAW, is a group of information technology professionals that work for government institutions throughout the state of Wisconsin. Our members represent municipalities, counties, special districts, tribes, and state agencies from every corner of our great state. We pride ourselves on our purpose and mission of collaboration and open information sharing that our members can take back to support their constituents and help to move Wisconsin forward.

name: HealthPartners
description:
HealthPartners is group health insurance carrier focused on the health and well-being in partnership with our members, patients, and community. 

Our insurance offers quality plans you want at a price you can manage.  We can help get the most out of your coverage whether you are covered through a Medicare plan, Individual plan or employer sponsored plan.

name: HPS/PayMedix
description: HPS/PayMedix is a Wisconsin-based healthcare solutions company that simplifies how healthcare is paid for and managed. By combining an extensive provider network with the PayMedix payment platform, we help employers reduce costs, improve employee access to care, and create a simpler billing experience. Members receive one consolidated statement and flexible payment options, while providers benefit from guaranteed payment and reduced collection risk.

name: ICC Innovation
description:
ICC Innovation, a technology initiative of the International Code Council, delivers high-value digital tools and solutions that streamline municipal and zoning code management, boost workflow efficiency, and advance building safety standards across communities. 
From the eCode360® online code platform and Laserfiche™ document automation tool, to ICC’s comprehensive building safety content and professional development services, ICC Innovation empowers municipalities to thoughtfully and effectively enhance their current and future operations.  
ICC Innovation is proud to support thousands of communities nationwide, continually improving products and processes, delivering responsive service and embracing a shared commitment to helping municipalities thrive and grow.

name: Innovative Public Advisors
description: Innovative Public Advisors (IPA) is a premier public sector executive recruitment and strategy firm dedicated to empowering municipalities with tailored solutions that enhance leadership, optimize operations, and drive positive community impact. Founded by experienced municipal professionals Jay Shambeau, ICMA-CM, MPA, and Jess Wildes, MPA, IPA offers a wide range of services including executive recruitment, interim services, grant writing, governance training, communications strategy, and strategic plan development. With a focus on delivering innovative, sustainable solutions, IPA is committed to helping local governments navigate complex challenges and strengthen their capacity to serve their communities effectively.

name: Johnson Controls
description: Johnson Controls helps local governments turn infrastructure needs into investment opportunities. Through innovative funding and accelerated project delivery, we help communities continually renew their buildings and infrastructure, improving resiliency, efficiency, and quality of life without relying solely on traditional capital funding. Contact Jeff Van Ess, Program Manager, jeff.vaness@jci.com

name: Kapur & Associates
description: Kapur is a full-service consulting engineering firm providing roadway design, capital improvement planning, water/storm/sanitary sewer design, survey, construction inspection and management, environmental services, landscape architecture, grant writing, and creating and managing TIF districts. Our corporate headquarters is in Milwaukee, with branch offices across the Midwest. Kapur has steadily grown to over 400 professionals and provides services to municipalities, DOTs, power companies, developers, railroads, water and sewer districts and school districts for over 45 years.

name: KerberRose
description: KerberRose, is a Wisconsin-based service corporation. We are a full-service regional firm of certified public accountants and management consultants providing audit, accounting, tax, payroll, consulting, human resource, strategic planning and investment advisory services. Our roots began in the City of Shawano, WI, in the late seventies, and we have been providing Trusted Advisor services since 1979. By providing quality, timely services to our clients, our firm has grown to include more than 180 team members located in 13 offices.

name: Kraemer Brothers
description: Kraemer Brothers is a Wisconsin-based construction management and general contracting firm with more than 75 years of experience serving public and private clients throughout the state. We partner with municipalities, counties, public safety agencies, libraries, schools, healthcare systems, and community organizations to deliver facilities that strengthen and serve communities. Our services include preconstruction, construction management, design-build, general contracting, and self-performed construction trades. As a third-generation family-owned company, we are committed to building lasting relationships through collaboration, transparency, and exceptional project outcomes.

name: Kunkel Engineering Group
description: Kunkel Engineering Group, a wholly owned subsidiary of Geo-Logic Associates, provides consulting, engineering, architectural, surveying, construction management, building inspection, funding procurement and grant administration services exclusively to municipal clients.  We currently work as Village, Town, and City Engineers for many communities within south central and southeast Wisconsin.

name: League Insurance
description: League Mutual Insurance provides insurance coverage and risk management services designed specifically for Wisconsin municipalities, helping cities and villages protect their people, property, and operations.

name: Lee Recreation
description: Lee Recreation, LLC is a Family-Owned Company. We have been supplying outdoor recreation equipment for over 30 years! We have established an excellent reputation in Wisconsin as a premier playground consultant when seeking to invest in new playground equipment, site furnishings, resilient surfacing and so much more!
